project_subtitle: Response-time behavior and accuracy patterns across 520 learners and four assessment domains.
project_blurb: 19,608 student responses across four technical subjects (Python, Pandas, SQL/DuckDB, Data Visualization). Source data came in four different formats. I loaded and cleaned them in Python, ran the analysis in 8 DuckDB SQL queries, then built this self-contained dashboard.
